description: Agent402 Bond Job Protocol v1. Read a seller's job quote (GET {url}/quote) and check it against this wallet's bond rules: seller in X402_BOND_SELLERS, price at most X402_BOND_MAX_USD, seller bond at least the minimum share, delivery time, the deal asset (USDC, or PREQ if enabled) and its daily cap. The URL host must be in X402_ALLOWED_DOMAINS. Never signs.
name: bond_job_quote
